headline: Executive order sets up military commissions to put certain non-citizens labeled unlawful enemy combatants on trial.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up military commissions to try non-citizens the government classifies as unlawful enemy combatants. Military commissions are courts run by the military rather than regular civilian courts. No summary was provided, so details such as trial rules and procedures are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Non-citizens held by the US as unlawful enemy combatants
who_it_affects.how: They may face trial before a military commission instead of a regular civilian court.

who_it_affects.group: US military and Defense Department officials
who_it_affects.how: They are responsible for running the military commission trials.
